s: Religion and government should be kept strictly separate, even if public life has less room for religious expression.
I lean toward keeping religion and government separate.
I lean toward letting government support and reflect religion.
Government should be free to support and reflect religion, even if people of other faiths or none feel left out.
church_state_tradeoff.torn: I weigh strict separation and room for religion about equally.

s: Laws should rest only on reasons everyone can share, not religious teaching, even when lawmakers are deeply religious.
I lean toward laws resting on shared reasons rather than religious teaching.
I lean toward lawmakers being free to base laws on their religious beliefs.
Lawmakers should be free to base laws on their religious beliefs, even if others don't share them.
faith_based_laws.torn: I weigh shared reasons and religious conviction about equally.

school_prayer: Public schools shouldn't organize prayer of any kind, including a moment of silence.
Public schools can hold a moment of silence, but no led prayer.
Teachers can lead prayer in public schools, as long as students can choose to skip it.
Public schools should hold a daily prayer led by the school.
ten_commandments: The Ten Commandments shouldn't be displayed in public school classrooms.
The Ten Commandments can be shown only as part of a display on the history of law, alongside other documents.
The Ten Commandments should be displayed in every public school classroom.
vouchers_religious_schools: Public tuition money should go only to non-religious private schools.
Families can use public tuition money at religious schools if religion classes are optional for those students.
Families should be able to use public tuition money at religious schools on equal terms with any other school.
religious_charter: A religious group shouldn't be able to run a publicly funded charter school that teaches its faith.
A religious group can run a publicly funded charter school if students can opt out of religious instruction.
A religious group should be able to run a publicly funded charter school that teaches its faith, like any other charter.
religious_exemptions: Religious exemptions from general laws should be rare; everyone should follow the same laws.
People should get religious exemptions only when the exemption doesn't harm anyone else.
People should usually get religious exemptions, unless the government has a very strong reason not to allow one.
religious_exemption_cases: This shouldn't get a religious exemption: {case}.
This should get a religious exemption: {case}.
christian_nation: The government shouldn't favor any religion, including by declaring the US a Christian nation.
The government shouldn't declare the US a Christian nation, but it can recognize the country's Christian heritage.
The US government should officially declare the US a Christian nation.
religious_country: It isn't important for the country that most Americans are religious.
It's somewhat important for the country that most Americans are religious.
It's very important for the country that most Americans are religious.
The country's success depends on most Americans being religious.
evolution_class: Public school science classes should teach only evolution.
Science classes should teach evolution and mention that many people hold religious beliefs about creation.
Science classes should teach creation or intelligent design alongside evolution as alternative explanations.
Science classes should teach creation or intelligent design instead of evolution.
faith_charities: Religious groups shouldn't get any public money, even to run shelters and addiction programs.
Religious charities can get public money to run services, if they keep religion out of them.
Religious charities should get public money on equal terms with others, even with faith content that people can opt out of.
